description: This file defines data structures and a loader related to usage cost analytics, including totals, daily summaries, and formatting functions.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageTotals
classes.description: Represents total usage and cost metrics for Gateway costs.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageDay
classes.description: Represents daily usage data including multiple metrics and total.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageSummary
classes.description: Contains overall summary data with daily breakdown and totals.

classes.name: CostUsageFormatting
classes.description: Provides static methods for formatting cost and token count values.

classes.name: CostUsageLoader
classes.description: Asynchronous loader to fetch usage cost summary data.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a Double cost value into USD string representation with variable decimal places.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats an integer token count into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes the usage cost summary data from a network request.
